name: Destined Disciple
body:
Destined disciples are called to be more than they are, more than they believe to be. Every step in life brings them nearer to their promised fate, and they choose to fully embrace this journey.

Requirements

To qualify to become a destined disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Weapon Focus.
Skills: Knowledge (history) 5 ranks.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the destined bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the destined bloodline.
Special: Must have a familiar, animal companion, or cohort.
Class Skills

The destined disciple’s class skills are Diplomacy (Cha), Handle Animal (Cha), Knowledge (history, local, nobility) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Table: Destined Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Continued service, legacy of blood, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), bloodline feat, fated	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Certain destiny	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Con +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, fated leader, resolve	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Int +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Greater resolve, natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Defy death	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+5	+3	Fated leader, true resolve	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the destined disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Destined disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, a destined disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a destined disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Legacy of Blood

A destined disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her destined disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the destined sorcerer bloodline, using her destined disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Continued Service

Choose one of the following class features: animal companion, banner, bravery, challenge, divine bond, familiar, favored enemy, mount, order, sacred armor, sacred weapon, weapon training. The character adds her destined disciple class levels to her effective class level in one class of her choice for the purpose of determining the effects of the chosen class feature. This doesn’t grant additional abilities.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a destined disciple gains a fated protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly adapts to her glorious destiny, a destined disciple gains stat boosts. as noted on Table 10: Destined Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a destined disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer destined bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager destined bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Fated (Su)

At 2nd level, the destined disciple gains the fated power of the sorcerer destined bloodline or the fated bloodrager power of the bloodrager destined bloodline (depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression), even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the destined disciple’s luck bonus on AC and saving throws increases by +2.

Certain Destiny (Su)

At 3rd level, the destined disciple gains the it was meant to be power of the sorcerer destined bloodline or the certain strike power of the bloodrager destined bloodline (depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression), even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the destined disciple can choose if to keep the result of her second die roll or not.

Fated Leader (Ex)

At 5th level, the destined disciple calculates the abilities of her familiar, animal companion, or cohort as if she was 1 level higher. If she has more than one of these features, she has to select which one to enhance.

At 10th level, she instead calculates the abilities of her familiar, animal companion, or cohort as if she was 2 levels higher.

Resolve (Ex)

Nothing can stand between a destined disciple and her fate. At 5th level, a destined disciple gains the samurai’s resolve ability. At 7th level, she gains greater resolve, and at 10th level, she gains true resolve.

Defy Death (Su)

At 9th level, the destined disciple gains the within reach power of the sorcerer destined bloodline or the defy death power of the bloodrager destined bloodline (depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression), even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, if the destined disciple succeeds at her Will save, she is left with a maximum number of hit points equal to her sorcerer or bloodrager level plus her destined disciple level. The destined disciple cannot gain hit points as a result of using this power.
